summary: Video platform (YouTube-like) on Internet Computer with monetization features being added, starting with Stripe Premium Subscription integration.
architectural_notes: Platform runs on Internet Computer (DFINITY) — uses Internet Identity for authentication, not email/password
Payment processing via Stripe for premium subscriptions
known_issues: Build failed twice when attempting to add monetization features simultaneously — breaking into smaller steps

existing_features.title: Integrate Stripe Checkout on the frontend so authenticated users can purchase a Premium subscription. Add a checkout flow on the Upgrade page that initiates a Stripe payment session. On successful payment confirmation, call the backend to mark the user as premium.
Replace the hardcoded free-tier return in useGetUserSubscriptionStatus.ts with a real backend call that fetches the authenticated user's subscription status.

new_feature_requests.summary: Stripe Premium Subscription integration for user monetization
Add a Premium Subscription tier to the backend: define a subscription status type (free/premium), store per-user subscription state, and expose functions to get and set a user's subscription status.
